unresolved.question: Whether the retained table's gi31, gi32 and gi33 bulb lights, which sit exactly at the three jet-bumper centres and are absent from the aGiTLights collection, are additional physical sockets on general-illumination string 03 or pure decoration.
unresolved.why_not_blocking: The manual itemizes no general-illumination string, so no printed count exists to contradict or confirm either reading. The definition therefore asserts no physical quantity for string 03 and states that its fourteen placements are the emitters the string is observed to drive rather than a complete socket inventory. An author gets fourteen correct emitter positions plus an explicit note; nothing authoring-critical is presented as settled.
